title: Amazon S3 to AWS Lambda
description: Create a Lambda function that receives events from S3.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Terraform template deploys a Lambda function, an S3 bucket and the IAM resources required to run the application. A Lambda function consumes ObjectCreated events from an Amazon S3 bucket. The Lambda code checks the uploaded file and console log the event.
